arguments.content: P1 review pattern: enabling an existing optional path by default can turn a latent opt-in boundary defect into a regression for unchanged callers. In a batch-report default flip, the populated-batch test and existing suite passed, but empty input newly reached an unconditional sum(values)/len(values), replacing the previous count-only result with ZeroDivisionError. Compare the actual review base and candidate across omitted, explicit-false and explicit-true modes and valid boundary inputs; distinguish inherited opt-in failures from newly exposed default failures. Preserve the count-only empty result by omitting mean calculation for empty batches, and cover both default and explicit detailed empty inputs. This pattern was verified against Git HEAD and staged blobs; it does not establish historical deployment behavior.
